notes: Curated taxonomy: tool CATEGORIES (never vendor brands) mapped to the ITM
DT*/PV* control ids each category implements. Authored knowledge, stable
across corpus sweeps; the RANKING against real cases is computed at read
time by the API (GET /tooling), never stored here.
Boundary rules (single-homing): every control id lives in exactly ONE
category, the one whose product class most squarely ships it, so category
scores never double-count a control. Collected-by-default OS/cloud event
logs -> SIEM; on-disk artifacts recovered at exam time -> DFIR readiness;
identity sign-in telemetry -> IAM; USB/print artifacts -> device control
(they are what device-control tooling monitors). PV001 ('No Ready
System-Level Mitigation') is deliberately unmapped - it is the absence of
a control. tests/test_tooling.py validates every id against
shared/data/itm_index.json so ITM catalog refreshes flag drift.
The 'examples' arrays are operator-curated ILLUSTRATIONS: common
products in each category, not endorsements and not derived from case
data. They are carried verbatim to the page detail and never enter the

categories.label: DLP / data egress control
categories.rationale: Content inspection and label telemetry at egress: the DLP solution controls themselves, MIP label activity, Defender print alerts, and watermark attribution of leaked media.

categories.label: EDR / endpoint protection
categories.rationale: Agents watching endpoint process/file behavior: EDR and AV agents, Sysmon process telemetry, anti-tamper alerting, file integrity monitoring, shadow-copy deletion.

categories.label: SIEM / central log management
categories.rationale: Central collection and retention of OS, audit-subsystem, and cloud control-plane event logs (Windows event logs, auditd, PowerShell logging, M365 UAL, AWS/GCP/Azure/OCI activity). Detection-side class: the catalog has no SIEM prevention.

categories.label: UEBA / behavior analytics
categories.rationale: Anomaly scoring over identity and endpoint telemetry: UBA/UEBA engines, impossible travel, performance-baseline profiling.

categories.label: Insider-risk platform / UAM
categories.rationale: Purpose-built insider-risk workflow: user activity monitoring agents, leaver watchlists, policy-violation patterning, communication compliance, insider-focused threat intel.

categories.label: Privileged access management
categories.rationale: Vaulting and brokering of privileged identities plus privileged-change telemetry: PIM audit, privileged-group membership changes, admin-privilege restriction, service-account scoping.

categories.label: IAM / identity governance
categories.rationale: Authentication events and identity lifecycle: sign-in logs, logon/logoff, account deletion, MFA, conditional access (incl. geographic), access reviews, account-ownership validation, identity verification at the service desk.

categories.label: SaaS / cloud collaboration security
categories.rationale: SaaS-app audit surfaces: Teams call history, Defender external-sharing alerts. Thin by catalog design - most cloud audit trails home under SIEM, retention under eDiscovery.

categories.label: Email security
categories.rationale: Mail-flow telemetry and egress rules: message trace, gateway logs, forwarding-rule and mailbox-permission alerts, auto-forward restriction, recipient-domain restriction.

categories.label: Network monitoring / NDR
categories.rationale: Wire-level visibility and enforcement: NIDS/NIPS, DNS logging+filtering, DPI, NetFlow, VPN and proxy logs, remote-access-platform traffic, NAC and network-access agents, segmentation, NGFW, protocol allow-listing, rogue IP-KVM discovery.

categories.label: Removable media / print control
categories.rationale: What device-control tooling monitors and blocks: the USB artifact set (registry, shellbags, setupapi, event logs, HID connections), print artifacts, mount restrictions, peripheral allow-listing, port security, print restriction.

categories.label: Physical security / access control
categories.rationale: Facility-side control plane: badge logs, CCTV, patrols, photo-ID comparison, badge-vs-auth discrepancy checks, tamper seals, thermal/visual baseline scans, zoning and escorts, device prohibitions on-site.

categories.label: Screening / HR & legal controls
categories.rationale: People-channel program controls: background/reference/criminal checks, ID verification, social-media screening+monitoring, HR early-threat collaboration, support programs, off-boarding, leave-contact rules, whistleblowing intake, NDAs, IP and exclusivity agreements, conflict-of-interest disclosure.

categories.label: Awareness & insider training
categories.rationale: Training program controls: end-user security awareness, insider-threat awareness, regulation awareness. Prevention-only class - no DT maps here.

categories.label: Cyber deception
categories.rationale: Tripwire assets whose only legitimate access count is zero: file canaries, honeypots, honey users, honey SPNs. Replaces the requested SOAR row - no ITM control maps to orchestration.

categories.label: Retention / eDiscovery & legal hold
categories.rationale: Preservation and review tooling the legal record depends on: Purview eDiscovery and holds, litigation hold, Slack retention/holds and export analysis.

categories.label: Policy / process governance
categories.rationale: Process controls and audits outside any sensor: acceptable-use/social-media/AI/classification policies, approval and enforcement processes, asset/data/software inventories, change management, spending limits, financial auditing (the record class courts convict on when org telemetry saw nothing).

categories.label: Endpoint hardening / MDM & GPO
categories.rationale: Managed-configuration surface: registry/file permissions, app whitelisting, disk encryption, MDM and clipboard policy, managed browsers and isolation, bootloader password, time-modification restriction and sync, proxy/snipping-tool disablement, DNS sinkholes, CI/CD static analysis. Prevention-only class.

categories.label: Forensics readiness / DFIR
categories.rationale: On-disk artifacts recovered at exam time, not collected live: browser history/cookies/extensions, LNK/prefetch/jump lists/shellbags, MFT and timestamp analysis, shell histories, WSL and RDP traces, snipping-tool caches, OneDrive SafeDelete, EXIF/metadata, hosts-file and registry footprints. Covers the requested backup/forensics row.
